data.title: Error Handling & Stream Recovery
data.goalStatement: The structured error-state system: a reusable error-card component (icon-in-circle, title, body, optional copyable command block, primary + secondary actions, footer diagnostic line) instantiated for adb-not-in-PATH ('Locate adb…' / 'Retry'), no-device-detected (kill-server command, 'Restart adb' / 'Boot emulator instead'), and multiple-devices-connected (inline device list rather than a modal, primary action naming the top device); plus the mid-session stream-drop banner that floats non-blockingly over the stale mirror, keeps staged annotations pinned, offers 'Reconnect', and leaves 'Resolve & Send' usable while disconnected. Why: research flags adb/scrcpy fragility across OS and device versions as the biggest execution risk to the >=95% first-attempt connect target, so recoverable failure is a product feature, not polish.
data.rawDescription: The structured error-state system: a reusable error-card component (icon-in-circle, title, body, optional copyable command block, primary + secondary actions, footer diagnostic line) instantiated for adb-not-in-PATH ('Locate adb…' / 'Retry'), no-device-detected (kill-server command, 'Restart adb' / 'Boot emulator instead'), and multiple-devices-connected (inline device list rather than a modal, primary action naming the top device); plus the mid-session stream-drop banner that floats non-blockingly over the stale mirror, keeps staged annotations pinned, offers 'Reconnect', and leaves 'Resolve & Send' usable while disconnected. Why: research flags adb/scrcpy fragility across OS and device versions as the biggest execution risk to the >=95% first-attempt connect target, so recoverable failure is a product feature, not polish.

functionalRequirements.text: Render structured error-card states (icon-in-circle, title, body, optional copyable command block, primary+secondary actions, footer diagnostic line) for: adb not in PATH, no device detected, and multiple devices connected (with an inline device list/picker instead of a modal, defaulting the primary action to the top-listed device).

On a mid-session stream drop, show a non-blocking floating banner over the stale mirror ('Stream dropped' / 'Your N annotations are kept on the frozen frame' / 'Reconnect'); staged annotations stay pinned and 'Resolve & Send' remains usable while disconnected.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Stream-drop handling must preserve all staged annotations without loss across a disconnect/reconnect cycle.
Device picker, annotation popovers, and error-card actions are fully keyboard-navigable (arrow keys/Enter for pickers, Enter/Escape for popovers).
All screens support full light and dark theme parity using the defined signal-color system (red = bug, green = fixed, orange = warning, blue = measurement) with sufficient contrast in both themes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given adb is not found on PATH, then an error card renders with the install command (with Copy), primary 'Locate adb…' and secondary 'Retry' actions.
Given no Android device is detected after launch, then an error card renders with the kill-server command and primary 'Restart adb' / secondary 'Boot emulator instead' actions.
Given 3 devices are connected simultaneously, then the error card shows an inline device list (not a modal) and the primary action names the top device (e.g. 'Mirror Pixel 8 Pro').

Given the stream drops mid-session with staged annotations present, then a non-blocking banner appears stating the stream dropped and that annotations are kept on the frozen frame, with a 'Reconnect' primary action; 'Resolve & Send' remains clickable and annotations remain pinned throughout.

scenarios.title: adb not on PATH
steps: Launch with adb missing from PATH
Error card renders with install command
User copies command or clicks Locate adb…/Retry

scenarios.title: No Android device detected
steps: adb present but no device attached
Error card renders with kill-server command
User runs suggested command or boots an emulator instead

scenarios.title: Multiple devices connected
steps: User accepts the top-named device or picks another

scenarios.title: Stream dropped mid-annotation
steps: Stream drops while annotations are staged
Non-blocking banner appears over the stale mirror
User clicks Reconnect or still sends via Resolve & Send

userStories.iWant: actionable error cards with copyable commands when adb is missing, no device is found, or several devices are attached
userStories.soThat: I can fix my own setup rather than filing a tooling ticket

userStories.iWant: my staged annotations to survive a mid-session stream drop and still be sendable
userStories.soThat: a flaky USB cable never costs me the bug report I just wrote
